classification.difficultyReason: Select useful statistics from an unscaffolded back-to-back display and justify differences in centre and spread.

inlines.text: The heights of Year 8 boys and girls are shown.
Comment on the differences between boys and girls with reference to summary statistics.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 11: back-to-back stem-and-leaf plot below the prompt, on the left.
spec.description: Unshaded back-to-back stem-and-leaf plot with Girls, Stem and Boys headings; two vertical separators; one horizontal header rule; eight stem rows including blank rows; and the complete key beneath. All lines and labels use black.
spec.answerVisibility: The headings, stems, leaves and key are permanent question givens. No calculated summary statistics or supplied answer text appear in the diagram.

inlines.text: Boys are taller on average, with a higher mean and median.
Girls’ heights are more spread out with a higher range.

answer.worked:
There are $15$ boys and $18$ girls. Their total heights are $2301$ cm and $2585$ cm, respectively.

$$\begin{align*}\bar{x}_{\text{boys}}&=\frac{2301}{15}\text{ cm}\\\bar{x}_{\text{boys}}&=153.4\text{ cm}\\\bar{x}_{\text{girls}}&=\frac{2585}{18}\text{ cm}\\\bar{x}_{\text{girls}}&=143\frac{11}{18}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Boys' median position}&=\frac{15+1}{2}\\\text{Boys' median position}&=8\\\text{Girls' median position}&=\frac{18+1}{2}\\\text{Girls' median position}&=9.5\end{align*}$$

The boys’ eighth height is $152$ cm. The girls’ ninth and tenth heights are $144$ cm and $145$ cm.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Boys' median}&=152\text{ cm}\\\text{Girls' median}&=\frac{144+145}{2}\text{ cm}\\\text{Girls' median}&=144.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Boys' range}&=(168-138)\text{ cm}\\\text{Boys' range}&=30\text{ cm}\\\text{Girls' range}&=(173-121)\text{ cm}\\\text{Girls' range}&=52\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

In these datasets, boys are taller on average because their mean and median are higher. Girls’ heights are more spread out because their range is larger.
